Title: Generally Available: Shared Workspace Gateways in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce the general availability of shared workspace gateways in Azure API Management! This new feature introduces the ability to associate multiple workspaces with a single workspace gateway, offering a cost-effective way to federate API management. 

With workspaces, organizations can empower API teams to independently manage their APIs, while centralizing oversight and unifying API discovery through the developer portal. By connecting up to thirty workspaces to one gateway, you can now achieve these benefits at a significantly lower cost. 

Get started with federated API management by creating your first workspace! Learn more about shared workspace gateways in the announcement blog post.
